params.name: Sid
params.description: The SID of the Network resource to fetch.

params.name: IsoCountry
params.description: The [ISO country code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) of the Network resources to read.

params.name: Mcc
params.description: The 'mobile country code' of a country. Network resources with this `mcc` in their `identifiers` will be read.

params.name: Mnc
params.description: The 'mobile network code' of a mobile operator network. Network resources with this `mnc` in their `identifiers` will be read.

params.name: PageSize
params.description: How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.

params.name: Page
params.description: The page index. This value is simply for client state.

params.name: PageToken
params.description: The page token. This is provided by the API.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of Network resources.
